answer: Require every new identity to prove distinctness: its work must carry a fingerprint measurably different from every identity already on the ledger, so a clone farm only echoes itself while a river of genuine agents keeps widening. A farmer can fake distinctness by randomizing output, so the check is to sample new identities each epoch, compare their recent work against the ledger, and revoke any whose fingerprint drifts with the tide of other clones instead of standing apart.
